-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.MemstorageInstance` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem memStorLogI_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k1 k2 : Nat)
    (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (es1 es2 : List EntryM) : memStorLogI st k1 dq1 es1 ∗ memStorLogI st k2 dq2
    es2 ⊢ ⌜LogAgree k1 es1 k2 es2⌝

theorem memStorEnd_to [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (e
    : Nat) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storEnd (memStorIface ms) e -∗ memEnd γs e

theorem memStorReg_same [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (ms1 ms2 : Loc)
    (γs1 γs2 : MemStorNames) (h1 : st = memStorIface ms1) (h2 : st = memStorIface ms2) : ⊢
    memStorReg ms1 γs1 -∗ memStorReg ms2 γs2 -∗ ⌜ms1 = ms2 ∧ γs1 = γs2⌝

theorem memStorLog_of [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k
    : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ memLog γs k dq es -∗ storLog
    (memStorIface ms) k dq es

theorem memStorReg_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs1 γs2 :
    MemStorNames) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs1 -∗ memStorReg ms γs2 -∗ ⌜γs1 = γs2⌝

def memStorRegAuth [MemStorReg GF] (M : GMap Loc MemStorNamesRec) : IProp GF :=
  ghostMapAuth (MemStorReg.memStorRegName GF) 1 M

structure MemStorReg.{u_1, u_2, u_3} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type where
  memStorRegName : GName

def memStorReg [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  ms ↪[MemStorReg.memStorRegName GF]□ γs.tuple

theorem memStorLogI_valid [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (dq :
    DFrac) (es : List EntryM) (hne : es ≠ []) : memStorLogI st k dq es ⊢ ⌜✓ dq⌝

theorem memStorage_isStorageP [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (wp_LastIndex :
    MemoryStorage.LastIndex.spec) (wp_FirstIndex : MemoryStorage.FirstIndex.spec) (wp_Term :
    MemoryStorage.Term.spec) (wp_Entries : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec) (wp_Snapshot :
    MemoryStorage.Snapshot.spec) (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) : ⊢ memStorInvP ms
    γs J -∗ memStorReg ms γs -∗ isStorageP J.SV (memBnd J) J.DL (memStorIface ms)

theorem memStorReg_persistent [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : Persistent
    (memStorReg ms γs)

theorem memStorCompactedI_mono [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (c c' :
    Nat) (h : c' ≤ c) : memStorCompactedI st c ⊢ memStorCompactedI st c'

def memStorLogI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(⌜es = []⌝ ∨ ∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memLog γs k dq es)

def memStorCompactedI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (c : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜c = 0⌝ ∨ ∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memCompacted γs c)

def memStorEndI [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (e : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms γs, ⌜st = memStorIface ms⌝ ∗ memStorReg ms γs ∗ memEnd γs e)

def memStorageModel [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] : StorageModel GF :=
  { storLog := memStorLogI, storEnd := memStorEndI, storCompacted := memStorCompactedI, storLog_app := ⋯,
    storLog_frac := ⋯, storLog_valid := ⋯, storLog_agree := ⋯, storLog_persist := ⋯, storLog_persistent := ⋯,
    storLog_nil := ⋯, storEnd_excl := ⋯, storCompacted_persistent := ⋯, storCompacted_zero := ⋯, storCompacted_mono := ⋯ }

theorem MemStorNames.rec_inj (γs1 γs2 : MemStorNames) (h : γs1.tuple = γs2.tuple) : γs1 = γs2

theorem memStorLogI_frac [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (dq1
    dq2 : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : memStorLogI st k (dq1 • dq2) es ⊣⊢ memStorLogI st k dq1 es ∗
    memStorLogI st k dq2 es

theorem memStorEnd_of [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (e
    : Nat) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ memEnd γs e -∗ storEnd (memStorIface ms) e

theorem memStorCompacted_to [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storCompacted (memStorIface ms) c -∗
    memCompacted γs c

theorem memStorEndI_excl [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (e e' : Nat) :
    memStorEndI st e ∗ memStorEndI st e' ⊢ False

theorem memStorReg_register [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (M : GMap Loc
    MemStorNamesRec) (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (h : M !! ms = none) : ⊢ memStorRegAuth M ==∗
    memStorRegAuth <[ms := γs.tuple]>M ∗ memStorReg ms γs

theorem memStorIface_inj [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms1 ms2 : Loc) : memStorIface
    ms1 = memStorIface ms2 → ms1 = ms2

def MemStorNamesRec : Type :=
  GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName × GName

theorem memStorLogI_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (dq
    : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : memStorLogI st k dq es ⊢ |==> memStorLogI st k DFrac.discard es

theorem memStorCompacted_of [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ memCompacted γs c -∗ storCompacted (memStorIface
    ms) c

theorem memStorLog_to [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k
    : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : ⊢ memStorReg ms γs -∗ storLog (memStorIface ms) k dq es
    -∗ memLog γs k dq es

theorem memStorLogI_app [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (st : Storage) (k : Nat) (dq :
    DFrac) (a b : List EntryM) : memStorLogI st k dq (a ++ b) ⊣⊢ memStorLogI st k dq a ∗ memStorLogI
    st (k + a.length) dq b

def memStorIface (ms : Loc) : Storage :=
  interface.mkOk MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType (intoVal ms)

theorem memLogL_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] [MemStorReg GF] (γ : GName) (k1 k2 : Nat) (dq1 dq2
    : DFrac) (es1 es2 : List EntryM) : memLogL γ k1 dq1 es1 ∗ memLogL γ k2 dq2 es2 ⊢ ⌜LogAgree k1
    es1 k2 es2⌝

def MemStorNames.tuple (γs : MemStorNames) : MemStorNamesRec :=
  (γs.log, γs.en, γs.ek, γs.cp, γs.jc, γs.sx, γs.lk, γs.hk)
